purpose: Exact compatibility registry for completed review records whose reviewedTreeHash predates canonical git-object fingerprinting. Historical validation accepts a source-less record with a non-reproducible hash ONLY when its full immutable identity appears here. Inferring legacy status from a hash mismatch alone would let a tampered record downgrade itself into structural-only validation.
rules: Keyed by the full tuple taskId + reviewedCommitSha + reviewedTreeHash + reviewedAt. Task id alone is not sufficient: a modified legacy record must not match.
Entries are immutable. Never add an entry to make a failing validation pass; a mismatch on a record that is not listed here is a real integrity failure.
This registry is closed. Every review recorded after canonical fingerprinting carries reviewedFingerprintSource and must never be added.

records.note: Expand candidate score model. Reviewed before canonical git-object fingerprinting; hash is working-tree bytes and is not reproducible from the commit.
